domain_features.name: Services
domain_features.description: A bookable offering with a name, duration, and price (e.g. '30-minute consultation').

domain_features.name: Providers / staff
domain_features.description: The person (or team member) who performs a service and owns a schedule.

domain_features.name: Bookable resources
domain_features.description: A non-human bookable unit (room, equipment, vehicle) with its own availability, alongside or instead of a provider.

domain_features.name: Availability rules / working hours
domain_features.description: A provider's (or resource's) recurring weekly working hours, from which bookable time slots are derived.

domain_features.name: Availability exceptions
domain_features.description: One-off overrides to the normal schedule for a specific date: holidays, custom hours, or extra availability.

domain_features.name: Time slot computation
domain_features.description: Derive bookable start times from availability rules, existing bookings, buffers, and slot interval.

domain_features.name: Buffers
domain_features.description: Padding time before and/or after a booking during which the provider/resource is not bookable.

domain_features.name: Bookings / appointments
domain_features.description: A confirmed reservation of a service with a provider (and/or resource) for a specific time slot.

domain_features.name: Recurring bookings
domain_features.description: Book the same service/slot on a repeating schedule (weekly, monthly) as a linked series.

domain_features.name: Group bookings / shared capacity
domain_features.description: Allow multiple attendees to book the same time slot up to a capacity limit (e.g. a class or webinar).

domain_features.name: Reminders
domain_features.description: Automated email/SMS reminders sent ahead of a booking.

domain_features.name: Cancellation and no-show policies
domain_features.description: Rules for how and when a booking can be cancelled or rescheduled, and how a no-show is recorded.

domain_features.name: Minimum booking notice
domain_features.description: A minimum lead time required between booking and the appointment start (blocks last-minute bookings).

domain_features.name: Deposits and paid bookings
domain_features.description: Collect a payment or deposit at the time of booking.

domain_features.name: Calendar sync
domain_features.description: Two-way sync of bookings with an external calendar (Google Calendar, Outlook, CalDAV).

domain_features.name: Out-of-office / blocked time
domain_features.description: Mark a provider unavailable for a date range (vacation, sick leave), blocking new bookings.

domain_features.name: Embeddable booking widget / public link
domain_features.description: A public, shareable booking page or embeddable widget for a service or provider.

domain_features.name: Booking webhooks
domain_features.description: Fire outbound events (booking created/cancelled/rescheduled) to external systems.

domain_features.name: Teams and round-robin assignment
domain_features.description: Assign a booking to one of several providers on a team, by availability, priority, or round robin.

domain_features.name: Manual booking approval
domain_features.description: Require a provider or manager to approve a requested booking before it is confirmed.

domain_features.name: Booking waitlist
domain_features.description: Let a customer join a waitlist for a fully booked slot and be notified if it opens up.

domain_features.name: Timezone-aware scheduling
domain_features.description: Display and book slots correctly across the customer's and provider's timezones.

domain_features.name: Contacts
domain_features.description: Individual people records with contact details, linked to companies, deals, and activities.

domain_features.name: Companies / accounts
domain_features.description: Organization records that group contacts and deals, with optional parent/subsidiary hierarchy.

domain_features.name: Leads
domain_features.description: Unqualified prospects captured before they become a contact/account and a deal.

domain_features.name: Lead conversion
domain_features.description: Convert a qualified lead into a contact, account, and an opportunity, preserving lineage back to the original lead.

domain_features.name: Deals / opportunities and pipelines
domain_features.description: Sales opportunities moving through one or more configurable pipelines and stages, with value and close date.

domain_features.name: Activities and tasks
domain_features.description: Calls, meetings, notes, and follow-up tasks logged against a contact, company, lead, or deal.

domain_features.name: Unified contact timeline
domain_features.description: A single chronological view of every activity, email, and document tied to a contact, company, or deal.

domain_features.name: Record assignment
domain_features.description: Assign a lead, deal, or account to a specific sales rep.

domain_features.name: Email sync
domain_features.description: Two-way email sync (IMAP/SMTP or provider OAuth) that logs sent/received email against the matching contact or deal.

domain_features.name: Calendar sync
domain_features.description: Sync meetings scheduled in the CRM with an external calendar (Google/Outlook) and vice versa.

domain_features.name: Campaign management
domain_features.description: Group leads and deals under a marketing campaign to track source and attribution.

domain_features.name: Segmentation
domain_features.description: Dynamic lists of contacts/leads built from filter criteria, used for targeted outreach.

domain_features.name: Quotes
domain_features.description: A priced proposal generated from a deal's line items, routed for internal approval before it is sent to the customer.

domain_features.name: Deal line items / product catalog
domain_features.description: A product/price catalog that can be attached as line items to a deal or quote.

domain_features.name: Pipeline automation
domain_features.description: Rule-based automation on deal/lead lifecycle events: stage-change timers, kill/recycle rules, scheduled follow-up cadences.

domain_features.name: Sales forecasting
domain_features.description: Pipeline-based revenue forecast, weighted by stage probability, often with recurring-revenue (MRR) tracking.

domain_features.name: Account hierarchy
domain_features.description: Parent/subsidiary relationships between company accounts, with rollup reporting.

domain_features.name: Sales reports and dashboards
domain_features.description: Pipeline, activity, and win/loss reporting dashboards for sales management.

domain_features.name: Bulk data import
domain_features.description: CSV import of segments/target lists and products, with a review step before committing records.

domain_features.name: Duplicate Detection and Merge
domain_features.description: Surface probable duplicate leads, contacts, or accounts and merge them into one surviving record, carrying related activity across.

domain_features.name: Consent and Marketing Preferences
domain_features.description: Record the lawful basis or consent behind holding a contact, and their opt-in/opt-out state per channel, so outbound sending can be suppressed at source.

domain_features.name: Contract (envelope) management
domain_features.description: [CORE] Create, own, assign, duplicate, cancel, archive and lock contracts; a contract groups documents, recipients, fields and an audit trail. Backend aggregate with optimistic version column for draft edits; list/detail UI with status and owner.

domain_features.name: Contract state machine
domain_features.description: [CORE] Explicit lifecycle draft→sent→in_progress→completed|declined|voided|expired→archived with guarded transitions and an event per transition. Backend: transition table plus DB-level compare-and-set; UI: status badge and timeline.

domain_features.name: Document management
domain_features.description: [CORE] Store, hash, version and serve the PDFs and attachments of a contract behind a file abstraction; immutable versions once sent. Backend: StorageObject + DocumentFile, metadata, upload validation; UI: upload with progress and validation errors.

domain_features.name: Upload validation and malware scanning
domain_features.description: [CORE] Reject non-PDF/allow-listed types by magic-byte sniffing, size/page caps, quarantine until a ClamAV scan is clean, PDF preflight rejecting JavaScript/OpenAction/Launch/EmbeddedFiles. Runs in a sandboxed worker with time and memory limits.

domain_features.name: Document processing pipeline
domain_features.description: [CORE] Queue-driven stages: preflight, scan, render thumbnails, extract text, flatten, stamp, seal, generate certificate. Idempotent BullMQ jobs with deterministic jobId; DB state, not the queue, is the source of truth.

domain_features.name: PDF viewer
domain_features.description: [CORE] Render pages with zoom, page navigation, rotation, thumbnails and minimap. Browser-only pdfjs-dist via react-pdf with a worker; mobile uses PDFium-based pdfrx. Large documents render lazily per page.

domain_features.name: Document preparation
domain_features.description: [CORE] Sender workspace: page thumbnails, field palette, recipient colour coding, properties panel, contextual toolbar, save/resume. Resizable panels layout; autosave with optimistic version.

domain_features.name: Field placement
domain_features.description: [CORE] Drag fields from a palette onto pages, then move, resize, duplicate, snap and align. Store page-relative 0–1 fractions in the unrotated CropBox space; convert to PDF points server-side. dnd-kit for palette drops, pointer events for move/resize.

domain_features.name: Field types and validation
domain_features.description: [CORE] Signature, initials, text, long text, email, phone, date, date/time, checkbox, radio, dropdown, number, currency, company, job title, attachment; each with a Zod-validated schema, required flag and recipient binding. Normalised field storage with a typed JSON config column for extensibility.

domain_features.name: Recipient management
domain_features.description: [CORE] Add signers, approvers, CCs and witnesses with role, order, status, internal/external flag and identity requirements; resend, reminder and per-recipient activity. Recipient status derived from events, not edited by hand.

domain_features.name: Signing order and routing
domain_features.description: [CORE] Sequential, parallel and mixed routing groups; optional recipients; the next group is notified only when the previous completes. Advance in the same transaction that records the signature.

domain_features.name: Signature capture
domain_features.description: [CORE] Adopt a signature by drawing (signature_pad), typing (font rendering) or uploading an image; reuse it across fields in one session; store as an image plus the method used. Touch-optimised on mobile.

domain_features.name: Initials capture
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Separate adopted initials reused on per-page initial fields with the same draw/type/upload methods.

domain_features.name: Electronic signing consent
domain_features.description: [CORE] Capture explicit consent to sign electronically and to receive records electronically before any field is shown; store text version, timestamp, IP and user agent. Consent text is versioned per jurisdiction.

domain_features.name: Signing session
domain_features.description: [CORE] Short-lived server session created after token exchange and any verification; carries recipient, contract version, assurance level and device signals; single active session per recipient; next-required-field navigation, progress and completion screen.

domain_features.name: Secure signing tokens
domain_features.description: [CORE] 32-byte CSPRNG base64url tokens; only the SHA-256 is stored; per-recipient expiry, single purpose, revocation and rotation (issue new, revoke old); constant-time compare.

domain_features.name: One-time-code verification
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Email/SMS OTP challenge: randomInt 6 digits, HMAC-SHA256 with server secret and challenge id, 10-minute TTL, 5 attempts, resend cooldown, per-IP and per-link Redis rate limits, lock the challenge not the account. Do not use a TOTP library for this.

domain_features.name: Signer identity verification levels
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Assurance ladder per recipient: link-only, email OTP, SMS OTP, access code, then ID document/KYC (see kyc_id_verification). Level recorded in signing evidence and shown on the certificate. Extends shared.identity_verification.

domain_features.name: Email delivery abstraction
domain_features.description: [CORE] Provider-independent EmailProvider interface (SMTP, SES, Postmark, Resend, SendGrid, Mailgun) with template rendering, idempotent sends, retries, and normalised delivery/bounce/complaint events verified per provider signature. Never mark delivered without a provider confirmation.

domain_features.name: Signing email notifications
domain_features.description: [CORE] Invitations, viewed, signed, completed, declined, voided and expiring emails from versioned, localised templates with variable insertion, sender branding and preview; completed-document delivery with certificate.

domain_features.name: SMS notifications and OTP delivery
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] SmsProvider interface (Twilio, Vonage, MessageBird, SNS) for OTP and invitation texts; per-recipient consent, country rules, delivery receipts normalised like email, cost/volume limits.

domain_features.name: In-app notification centre
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Activity inbox for senders: signed, viewed, declined, expiring, bounced, with read state and deep links. Builds on shared.notifications.

domain_features.name: Reminders and expiry
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Scheduled reminder cadence per contract and automatic expiry with a final warning; scheduler creates uniquely-keyed jobs so a reminder is sent at most once per recipient per slot; cancellable on completion.

domain_features.name: Document and contract versioning
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Immutable ContractVersion and DocumentFile rows; edits before send create a new draft version, after send require void-and-recreate or a corrected copy; version list and diff metadata.

domain_features.name: Document hashing and integrity
domain_features.description: [CORE] SHA-256 over exact stored bytes on upload, at send, and for the final sealed PDF, streamed; hashes go into the audit trail and certificate; hash verified on every download.

domain_features.name: Final PDF generation
domain_features.description: [CORE] After the last signature, flatten fields, stamp signature images and values, append the completion certificate, then seal once. Runs in exactly one job guarded by a row-level completion claim; uses @cantoo/pdf-lib server-side, never in the browser.

domain_features.name: Immutable signed documents
domain_features.description: [CORE] Sealed PDFs are write-once: object-lock or no-overwrite key policy, new hash on any change, corrected copies are new versions. Deletion only through retention policy.

domain_features.name: Completion certificate
domain_features.description: [CORE] Appended PDF listing signers, emails, authentication level, IPs, user agents, timestamps, the event list and document hashes, generated with pdfkit. Vendor layouts are unverified; design the layout independently.

domain_features.name: Immutable audit trail
domain_features.description: [CORE] Append-only audit events with actor, IP, user agent, correlation id and document hash; REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE plus a BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger; per-contract hash chain (prev_hash, hash over canonical JSON) serialised by locking the contract row; no global chain. Extends shared.audit_log.

domain_features.name: Public verification page
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Public page/API where anyone with the document or a QR code can upload or look up a sealed PDF and see whether its hash matches a stored VerificationRecord, without exposing content. Rate-limited, no enumeration.

domain_features.name: Secure downloads
domain_features.description: [CORE] Short-lived pre-signed URLs or a streaming proxy after an authorisation check; Content-Disposition attachment, nosniff, hash check, download audit event; recipients get only their permitted files.

domain_features.name: Storage abstraction (S3-compatible)
domain_features.description: [CORE] StorageProvider interface over S3/R2/MinIO with tenant-prefixed keys, server-side encryption, multipart uploads, lifecycle policies and object lock support; builds on shared.file_storage.

domain_features.name: Webhooks
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Per-organisation endpoints and event subscriptions; Standard Webhooks signing (id.timestamp.payload HMAC-SHA256), whsec_ secrets, dual secrets during rotation, SSRF-safe URL validation.

domain_features.name: Webhook retry and dead-letter
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] BullMQ exponential backoff with jitter over days, per-attempt delivery log, terminal failed state as dead-letter, manual redrive, replay protection with a 5-minute timestamp tolerance (spec sets none).

domain_features.name: Search and filtering
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Contract search by name, number, recipient, email, company, reference and metadata using Postgres tsvector + GIN and pg_trgm; filter by status, date, owner, template; URL-state filters. External engine only if measured too slow. Builds on shared.search.

domain_features.name: Exports and reports
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] CSV/PDF export of contracts, audit events and activity with tenant scoping, async jobs for large sets and expiring download links. Extends shared.import_export.

domain_features.name: Templates
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Reusable documents with named recipient roles, pre-placed fields and variables; draft/published/archived workflow, versioning, variable picker and preview; create contract from template.

domain_features.name: Organisation branding
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Logo, colours, sender name and email domain applied to signing pages and emails with contrast checks; custom domain optional.

domain_features.name: RBAC and permission overrides
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Organisation roles with per-contract or per-template overrides (view, edit, send, void); authorisation on every mutation at the object level, not only the route. Extends shared.permissions.

domain_features.name: Multi-tenancy and isolation
domain_features.description: [CORE] Tenant context via AsyncLocalStorage (nestjs-cls), one transactional wrapper that sets app.tenant_id with set_config(...,true) under a non-owner role, Postgres RLS as defence in depth, tenant in every job payload and storage/cache/search key, tenant scoped webhook secrets.

domain_features.name: Concurrency control and idempotency
domain_features.description: [CORE] Sign in a transaction with SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the contract, count remaining signers, so exactly one transaction sees last signer; unique(recipient_id) on signature; Idempotency-Key table unique(tenant,key); jobId dedupe is a hint, not the guarantee; optimistic version only for draft edits.

domain_features.name: Rate limiting and anti-abuse
domain_features.description: [CORE] Redis limits per IP, token, recipient, tenant and endpoint; OTP and public-verification throttling; upload quotas; bot challenge on public links; abuse events to security log.

domain_features.name: Security events
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Dedicated stream for failed OTPs, token reuse, revoked-link access, cross-tenant denials, webhook signature failures and admin actions with alerting hooks; feeds SIEM.

domain_features.name: Admin security settings
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Organisation settings for allowed verification levels, MFA/SSO enforcement, IP allow-lists, session lifetime, API keys, retention and webhook secrets; changes audited.

domain_features.name: Observability
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Structured logs with correlation ids, OpenTelemetry traces across API, queue and worker, queue depth and job-failure metrics, alerts on stuck completion jobs; never log tokens or document content. Extends shared.logging.

domain_features.name: Internationalisation and RTL
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] English and Persian: next-intl, Tailwind logical utilities, Vazirmatn for Persian, Intl for numbers/dates/calendars (fa-IR-u-ca-persian), translated validation messages, per-recipient signing language; audit trail stays UTC/ISO. PDF field coordinates never flip with UI direction. Extends shared.i18n.

domain_features.name: GDPR and retention
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Per-tenant retention policy, scheduled deletion of documents and evidence, data export and erasure reconciled with audit retention, legal hold overrides, lawful-basis and consent records. Technical considerations only.

domain_features.name: Legal hold
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Freeze deletion of selected contracts and evidence regardless of retention policy, with reason, actor and release audit.

domain_features.name: Data residency
domain_features.description: [FUTURE] Per-tenant region for storage, database and processing; region-aware endpoints and job routing.

domain_features.name: Billing readiness
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Metering of sent envelopes, SMS and storage per tenant, plan entitlements and quota enforcement hooks so billing can be attached later. Builds on shared.billing.

domain_features.name: Public API, API keys and sandbox
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Versioned REST API with OpenAPI, scoped hashed API keys, idempotency keys, cursor pagination, error envelope, sandbox tenant and SDK examples; webhooks documented alongside.

domain_features.name: Domain testing strategy
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Reusable tests and fixtures for tenant isolation, authorisation, state transitions, concurrent signing, idempotency, token reuse, OTP abuse, upload attacks, webhook replay, PDF correctness (rotated and CropBox-offset PDFs), email/SMS retries and job failures.

domain_features.name: Backup and disaster recovery
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Database PITR plus object-storage versioning and cross-region copy of sealed documents; documented restore drills and integrity re-verification of hashes after restore.

domain_features.name: Mobile signing
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Responsive web signing and a Flutter signing flow: touch signature, sticky bottom actions, progress, field-to-field navigation, OTP entry, biometric app unlock, secure token storage, completion screen.

domain_features.name: Decline, void and correct
domain_features.description: [IMPORTANT] Signer declines with a reason; sender voids with reason and notifies recipients; corrections create a new version and re-route. All are terminal transitions with audit events and webhooks.

domain_features.name: Delegation and reassign
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] A recipient delegates to another person or the sender reassigns before signing; old token revoked, new identity checked, chain of custody recorded.

domain_features.name: Witness and in-person signing
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Witness recipients countersign; in-person mode hands the device to a signer on the sender's session with host authentication.

domain_features.name: Bulk send
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Send one template to many recipients from a CSV with per-row validation, throttled queue and a batch report.

domain_features.name: Public signing links
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Self-service link/QR where anyone fills and signs a template (forms, waivers), with bot protection and per-link quotas; each submission becomes a contract.

domain_features.name: Conditional and calculated fields
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Show/require fields based on other values; computed numbers and formulas evaluated with a safe expression evaluator, never eval.

domain_features.name: Attachment requests
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Signer uploads supporting documents (ID, proof) into the contract through an attachment field with the same upload security as sender files.

domain_features.name: Embedded signing
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Signing UI embeddable in a customer app via short-lived session URL and postMessage events, with CSP frame-ancestors allow-list.

domain_features.name: SSO and SCIM provisioning
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] SAML/OIDC login and SCIM user provisioning for organisations. Depends on shared.auth; connectors delegated to an existing SSO layer.

domain_features.name: Approval workflow
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Internal approvers review a draft before it is sent to external signers; approve/reject with comments as a routing step.

domain_features.name: Comments and collaboration
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Threaded comments on a contract or a field between internal users, mentions and notifications; never visible to external signers unless shared.

domain_features.name: Contract repository and renewals
domain_features.description: [OPTIONAL] Metadata (counterparty, value, dates), expiry and renewal reminders, folders and tags for completed contracts: a light CLM layer over the signed archive.

domain_features.name: Advanced and qualified signatures
domain_features.description: [FUTURE] Interface-only extension point for AdES/QES: SignatureProvider, KMS/HSM key custody, trust-service-provider integration, PAdES-B-B via signpdf, RFC 3161 timestamps via pkijs, B-LT/LTA as custom work. No fake certificates or hand-rolled crypto.

domain_features.name: Document and KYC verification
domain_features.description: [FUTURE] Provider-based ID document and liveness check before signing, result stored as evidence reference not raw images; consent and retention limits. Extends shared.identity_verification.

domain_features.name: AI contract intelligence
domain_features.description: [FUTURE] Optional capabilities using the kit's ai/ layer: summarisation, clause extraction, risk flags, metadata and template-variable extraction, OCR, classification, semantic search, comparison, missing-signature detection, anomaly detection. Off by default, per-tenant opt-in, no training on tenant content.

domain_features.name: Catalog / Product Management
domain_features.description: Create and maintain products with variants, options, media, and attributes.

domain_features.name: Categories / Collections
domain_features.description: Organize products into browsable categories or curated collections.

domain_features.name: Inventory Management
domain_features.description: Track stock levels per variant and location, reserve stock on order, and release it on cancellation.

domain_features.name: Shopping Cart
domain_features.description: Let a shopper accumulate items, adjust quantities, and apply a promotion code before checking out.

domain_features.name: Checkout
domain_features.description: Collect shipping/billing details, shipping method, and payment, then convert a cart into an order.

domain_features.name: Orders & Order State Machine
domain_features.description: Track an order through payment, fulfillment, and completion, or cancellation/return, as the single source of truth for what was sold.

domain_features.name: Payments
domain_features.description: Authorize, capture, and refund payment for an order through one or more payment providers.

domain_features.name: Shipping & Fulfilment
domain_features.description: Choose a shipping method/rate at checkout, then pack and ship the order via a fulfillment provider or in-house.

domain_features.name: Returns & Refunds
domain_features.description: Let a customer request a return or exchange for a delivered order, and process the refund once received.

domain_features.name: Promotions & Discounts
domain_features.description: Configure percentage/fixed discounts, coupon codes, and automatic promotions with eligibility rules.

domain_features.name: Customer Accounts
domain_features.description: Let a shopper register, sign in, and view their order history, addresses, and saved payment methods.

domain_features.name: Guest Checkout
domain_features.description: Let a shopper complete an order without creating an account.

domain_features.name: Reviews & Ratings
domain_features.description: Let a verified purchaser leave a rating and written review on a product.

domain_features.name: Tax Calculation

domain_features.description: Computing net material shortages from demand (sales/production orders) against on-hand and incoming stock, and suggesting or triggering replenishment.

domain_features.name: Inventory, lots, and serials
domain_features.description: Tracking on-hand quantity by location, with optional lot/batch or unique serial number identity per stock item.

domain_features.name: Stock locations
domain_features.description: A hierarchical structure of physical storage locations (warehouse, area, bin) that stock items belong to.

domain_features.name: Purchase orders
domain_features.description: Ordering raw materials or components from a supplier to fulfil production needs.

domain_features.name: Supplier management
domain_features.description: Supplier records and the mapping of which supplier part fulfils which internal item.

domain_features.name: Quality inspections
domain_features.description: Recording pass/fail test results against defined test templates for a part or a specific stock item/serial.

domain_features.name: Non-conformance management
domain_features.description: Logging and dispositioning a failed inspection or production defect: quarantine, rework, scrap, or use-as-is.

domain_features.name: Equipment maintenance
domain_features.description: Scheduling and recording preventive or corrective maintenance for a work center or piece of equipment.

domain_features.name: Shop-floor data collection
domain_features.description: A mobile/tablet interface for operators to scan barcodes, report progress, and record quantities directly at the work center.

domain_features.name: Traceability
domain_features.description: Tracing which input lots/serials went into which output lot/serial, forward (where did this batch ship) and backward (what components are in this unit).

domain_features.name: Disassembly / unbuild
domain_features.description: Reversing a production order: breaking a built item back down into its component stock, e.g. for rework.

domain_features.name: Subcontracting
domain_features.description: Sending components to an external vendor to perform an operation, receiving back a finished or semi-finished item.

domain_features.name: Product variants
domain_features.description: Multiple sellable/buildable variants of a base template item (e.g. by size or color) sharing a common BOM structure.

domain_features.name: Stocktake / cycle counting
domain_features.description: Periodically counting physical inventory and reconciling it against system quantity.

domain_features.name: Manufacturing cost tracking
domain_features.description: Rolling up material, labor (work center hours), and overhead cost into a produced item's cost.

domain_features.name: Work center capacity planning
domain_features.description: Visualizing and planning work center load (queued, in-progress, blocked, late work orders) to balance capacity.

domain_features.name: Production scrap tracking
domain_features.description: Recording material lost or discarded during production, separate from planned by-products.

domain_features.name: By-products and co-products
domain_features.description: Secondary items produced alongside the primary output of a production order, as defined on the BOM.

domain_features.name: Workspaces
domain_features.description: A top-level container for an organization's projects, members, and settings.

domain_features.name: Projects
domain_features.description: A container for a related set of tasks, with its own members, states, and settings, inside a workspace.

domain_features.name: Tasks / issues
domain_features.description: The core unit of work: a title, description, assignees, priority, dates, and status, belonging to a project.

domain_features.name: Subtasks
domain_features.description: Breaking a task down into smaller child tasks tracked toward the parent's completion.

domain_features.name: Statuses and workflows
domain_features.description: Configurable per-project statuses (grouped into backlog/unstarted/started/completed/cancelled) that define a task's workflow.

domain_features.name: Kanban boards
domain_features.description: A visual board of columns (statuses) and swimlanes, with drag-and-drop task cards.

domain_features.name: Task dependencies
domain_features.description: Linking tasks with typed relations (blocks, relates to, duplicates, must-start/finish-before) to sequence work.

domain_features.name: Comments and mentions
domain_features.description: Threaded discussion on a task, with @-mentions and emoji reactions.

domain_features.name: Cycles / sprints
domain_features.description: A fixed-duration iteration (sprint) that a set of tasks is planned into and executed within.

domain_features.name: Modules / epics
domain_features.description: A larger unit of work (feature or epic) that groups related tasks, independent of the sprint/cycle timeline.

domain_features.name: Milestones
domain_features.description: A target date marking a significant point in a project, used to group and track progress toward a deliverable.

domain_features.name: Gantt / timeline view
domain_features.description: A horizontal timeline view of tasks by start/target date, showing dependencies and overlaps.

domain_features.name: Time tracking
domain_features.description: Logging time spent on a task, by whom and when, for effort reporting.

domain_features.name: Labels
domain_features.description: Free-form or predefined tags applied to tasks for categorization and filtering.

domain_features.name: Attachments
domain_features.description: Uploading files to a task for reference (screenshots, documents, designs).

domain_features.name: Saved views and filters
domain_features.description: Saving a combination of filters, sort order, and grouping as a reusable view.

domain_features.name: Guest / client access
domain_features.description: A restricted external member role for clients or stakeholders to view or comment on specific projects without full workspace access.

domain_features.name: Activity feed
domain_features.description: A chronological, per-task or per-project audit trail of field changes, status moves, and comments.

domain_features.name: Estimates / story points
domain_features.description: Sizing a task's effort, either as a raw point value or against a project-defined estimate scale.

domain_features.name: Recurring tasks
domain_features.description: Automatically regenerating a task on a schedule once the previous occurrence is completed.

domain_features.name: Workload / capacity view
domain_features.description: Visualizing how much work is assigned to each person to spot over/under-allocation.

domain_features.name: Burndown and velocity reports
domain_features.description: Charting remaining work over a cycle (burndown) and completed points per cycle over time (velocity).

domain_features.name: View sharing
domain_features.description: Sharing a saved view publicly or with specific teammates.

domain_features.name: Intake / triage
domain_features.description: A lightweight submission form (often for non-members) that creates a triage-state task for a maintainer to accept or reject.

domain_features.name: Favorites / pinning
domain_features.description: Letting a user pin frequently-used projects, views, or tasks for quick access.

domain_features.name: Private projects
domain_features.description: Restricting a project's visibility to explicitly invited members within the workspace.

domain_features.name: Property listings
domain_features.description: Create and manage for-sale/for-rent listings for a property or unit, with pricing and status.

domain_features.name: Listing media
domain_features.description: Attach photos, floor plans, and video/virtual tours to a listing.

domain_features.name: Search and map
domain_features.description: Public-facing search with filters (price, beds, location) and a map view of results.

domain_features.name: Saved searches and alerts
domain_features.description: Let a buyer/renter save a search and get notified of new matching listings.

domain_features.name: Lead capture / inquiries
domain_features.description: Capture a prospect's contact request against a listing.

domain_features.name: Lead / pipeline management
domain_features.description: Track and follow up on leads through a pipeline (new, contacted, qualified, won, lost).

domain_features.name: Viewings / showings
domain_features.description: Schedule a property viewing between a prospect and an agent.

domain_features.name: Open houses
domain_features.description: Publish a scheduled open-house event for a listing and track attendee sign-ins.

domain_features.name: Agent / broker directory
domain_features.description: Manage agents/brokers, their profile, license info, and listing assignments.

domain_features.name: Brokerage / agency management
domain_features.description: Manage a multi-agent brokerage: office roster, listing assignment, commission splits.

domain_features.name: Offers and negotiation
domain_features.description: Submit, counter, and accept/reject purchase or rental offers on a listing.

domain_features.name: Lease management
domain_features.description: Create and manage a lease/rental agreement between a tenant and a property/unit.

domain_features.name: Tenant management
domain_features.description: Track tenants, their contact info, lease history, and communication.

domain_features.name: Rent collection
domain_features.description: Generate rent invoices and collect recurring payments from tenants.

domain_features.name: Security deposit management
domain_features.description: Collect, hold, and reconcile a tenant's security deposit against a lease.

domain_features.name: Maintenance requests
domain_features.description: Let a tenant report an issue and track it through to resolution via a work order.

domain_features.name: Owner portfolio dashboard
domain_features.description: Give an owner a rollup view of their properties' occupancy, income, and maintenance status.

domain_features.name: Document management
domain_features.description: Store lease agreements, disclosures, inspection reports, and other property documents.

domain_features.name: Valuations / comparative market analysis
domain_features.description: Estimate a property's market value from comparable listings/sales.

domain_features.name: Mortgage / affordability calculator
domain_features.description: Estimate monthly payments for a listed sale price given rate/term/down-payment inputs.

domain_features.name: MLS / IDX feed integration
domain_features.description: Pull in or syndicate listings via an MLS's IDX feed or RESO Web API.

domain_features.name: Listing syndication
domain_features.description: Publish a listing out to third-party portals in addition to the operator's own site.

domain_features.name: 3D / virtual tours
domain_features.description: Embed a 3D walkthrough or 360° tour on a listing.

domain_features.name: Owner portal
domain_features.description: Self-service access for an owner to view their properties, statements, and requests.

domain_features.name: Tenant portal
domain_features.description: Self-service access for a tenant to pay rent, view lease documents, and submit maintenance requests.

domain_features.name: Rental application and screening
domain_features.description: Collect a prospective tenant's application and run background/credit checks.

domain_features.name: Fair housing compliance screening
domain_features.description: Flag listing copy or screening criteria that risks violating fair-housing / anti-discrimination rules.

domain_features.name: Commission tracking
domain_features.description: Calculate and track agent/broker commission owed per closed transaction.

domain_features.name: AI price recommendation
domain_features.description: Suggest a listing or renewal price using comparable listings and market trend data.

domain_features.name: Tables and floor plan
domain_features.description: Define dining areas, tables, and seating capacity; visual floor-plan layout with per-table status (available, occupied, reserved, cleaning).

domain_features.name: Menu management
domain_features.description: Categories, items, prices, and availability windows for a restaurant's sellable menu.

domain_features.name: Menu modifiers and variants
domain_features.description: Add-ons, size options, ingredient substitutions, and combo choices attached to a menu item.

domain_features.name: Table reservations
domain_features.description: Book a table for a date/time and party size; capacity and time-window conflict checking.

domain_features.name: Walk-in waitlist
domain_features.description: Queue walk-in parties without a reservation; estimated wait time and notify-when-ready.

domain_features.name: Dine-in order taking
domain_features.description: Capture an order against a table/seat, send to kitchen, and track status through to billing.

domain_features.name: Kitchen display system (KDS)
domain_features.description: Route order tickets to kitchen stations, track prep status, and flag delayed items in real time.

domain_features.name: POS integration
domain_features.description: Connect to or embed a point-of-sale system for order capture and payment settlement.

domain_features.name: In-restaurant payment capture
domain_features.description: Charge a table's bill through a payment provider; supports pay-at-table and receipt printing.

domain_features.name: Split bills
domain_features.description: Divide a table's bill by item, by seat, or evenly across a party.

domain_features.name: Tips and gratuity
domain_features.description: Capture tip amount at payment and record it against the server/order for payout and reporting.

domain_features.name: Takeout / pickup orders
domain_features.description: Orders placed for customer pickup rather than dine-in; no table assignment.

domain_features.name: Delivery orders
domain_features.description: Orders fulfilled by delivery to a customer address, with own or third-party couriers.

domain_features.name: Third-party delivery marketplace integration
domain_features.description: Publish menu and receive orders from delivery marketplaces (e.g. aggregator apps).

domain_features.name: Ingredient inventory
domain_features.description: Track stock levels of ingredients and supplies used to prepare menu items.

domain_features.name: Recipes and yield
domain_features.description: Bill-of-materials per menu item: ingredient quantities and yield, used to cost dishes and deplete stock.

domain_features.name: Staff shift scheduling
domain_features.description: Plan and publish staff work shifts and track clock-in/clock-out.

domain_features.name: Loyalty and rewards
domain_features.description: Points, punch cards, or tiered rewards tied to a guest's order history.

domain_features.name: Customer reviews and ratings
domain_features.description: Collect and display post-visit ratings/feedback tied to an order or visit.

domain_features.name: Online ordering
domain_features.description: Customer-facing web/app storefront for takeout and delivery ordering against the live menu.

domain_features.name: Allergen and nutrition labelling
domain_features.description: Flag allergens and (where required) publish calorie/nutrition information per menu item.

domain_features.name: QR code table ordering
domain_features.description: Guests scan a table QR code to view the menu and order from their own device.

domain_features.name: Gift cards
domain_features.description: Sell and redeem stored-value gift cards.

domain_features.name: Self-service kiosk ordering
domain_features.description: In-store kiosk for customers to browse the menu, order, and pay without staff assistance.

domain_features.name: Multi-location management
domain_features.description: Manage menus, pricing, and reporting across a chain of restaurant locations from one account.

domain_features.name: Ticket management
domain_features.description: Create, view, update, and track support tickets/conversations through a status lifecycle.

domain_features.name: Queues / inboxes
domain_features.description: Group tickets into queues, inboxes, or departments so teams see only the tickets relevant to them.

domain_features.name: Ticket assignment
domain_features.description: Assign a ticket to a specific agent, and reassign it as needed.

domain_features.name: SLA management
domain_features.description: Define first-response and resolution time targets per priority/queue and track tickets against them.

domain_features.name: Escalation
domain_features.description: Automatically escalate a ticket (reassign, notify a manager, raise priority) when it breaches its SLA.

domain_features.name: Email channel
domain_features.description: Create and reply to tickets via email, with reply threading matched back to the original ticket.

domain_features.name: Live chat channel
domain_features.description: A website chat widget that creates and updates tickets in real time.

domain_features.name: Voice / phone channel
domain_features.description: Log a phone call as a ticket, optionally integrated with an IVR or call system.

domain_features.name: Knowledge base
domain_features.description: Public and/or internal help-center articles, organized into categories, with search.

domain_features.name: Macros / canned responses
domain_features.description: Saved reply templates and/or bulk multi-step actions an agent can apply to a ticket in one click.

domain_features.name: CSAT surveys
domain_features.description: Send a post-resolution customer satisfaction survey and record the rating/feedback.

domain_features.name: Customer self-service portal
domain_features.description: A logged-in area where a customer can view, create, and track their own tickets.

domain_features.name: Internal notes
domain_features.description: Private, agent-only notes on a ticket that the customer never sees, distinct from customer-visible replies.

domain_features.name: Tags and categorization
domain_features.description: Apply free-form tags or fixed categories to tickets for filtering and reporting.

domain_features.name: Business hours / holiday calendar
domain_features.description: Define operating hours and holidays that SLA countdown timers pause outside of.

domain_features.name: Automation rules
domain_features.description: Trigger-based automation on ticket events (time-based or field-change), e.g. auto-tag, auto-assign, or notify.

domain_features.name: Reporting and analytics
domain_features.description: Dashboards on ticket volume, agent performance, and SLA compliance.

domain_features.name: Unified multichannel inbox
domain_features.description: Present tickets from every channel (email, chat, voice, social) in one inbox per customer, rather than siloed by channel.
